name: dependency-observations.invalid.n04.resolution-without-evidence
basis: The one store-level resolution hard law (CHECK): resolved_ref_product_id NOT NULL implies resolution_evidence NOT NULL. Under the 030 §1 sample-3 mislink evidence a resolution must carry its reconciliation evidence; a bare resolved reference is refused at the store boundary, not merely flagged downstream.
reject_law: CHECK (resolved_ref_product_id IS NULL OR resolution_evidence IS NOT NULL)
